title: Survey Dataset
description: A geometric survey dataset (point cloud, photogrammetric model, etc.) acquired from a heritage asset. Profiles digital-representation (CRMdig D1 / E73 Information Object) and adds a CRMdig D7 acquisition event sub-object and a mandatory spatial coverage geometry.

oneOf.description: Survey dataset with its own embedded coverage geometry.

type.description: Fixed type token identifying this record as a survey dataset (maps to crmdig:D1_Digital_Object).

acquisitionEvent.description: CRMdig D7 Digital Machine Event recording the survey acquisition: the method, equipment, operator, date and spatial/quality parameters.

acquisitionMethod.description: Acquisition technique label or controlled-vocabulary URI (e.g. "TLS", "UAV-photogrammetry", "SLAM", "structured-light", "terrestrial-photogrammetry").

acquisitionDate.description: Date (ISO 8601) on which the survey data was collected.

operator.description: URI of the person or organisation who carried out the survey.

equipment.description: Make and model of the primary acquisition instrument.

crs.description: EPSG URI for the coordinate reference system of the output data (e.g. https://www.opengis.net/def/crs/EPSG/0/32632).

density.description: Point density or ground sampling distance (e.g. "~3500 pts/m²", "3 cm/pixel GSD").

accuracy.description: Stated absolute or relative accuracy of the dataset (e.g. "±3 mm").

processingHistory.description: Software and processing steps applied before delivery (registration, noise filtering, etc.).

coverage.description: GeoJSON geometry delineating the spatial extent of the surveyed area (polygon or bounding box in WGS 84 unless stated otherwise in acquisitionEvent.crs).

limitations.description: Known limitations, coverage gaps or quality caveats of the dataset.

reviewStatus.description: Workflow status of this record (e.g. draft, reviewed, approved).
